style: Photorealistic high-end editorial food and lifestyle photography for a premium Instagram page, vertical 2:3 frame. Modern luxury home kitchen for an upper-middle-class family: large honed Calacatta marble island with soft grey veining, warm white-oak cabinetry, brushed brass tap and handles, tall windows with sheer linen curtains, soft diffused morning daylight, calm neutral palette (cream, warm white, oak, brass) with subtle dusty-pink accents (#D4A5A5) in linen and ceramics. Styled props: handmade ceramic bowls, ribbed glass, linen napkins, a small vase of fresh flowers. Shallow depth of field, clean composition, rich but natural colour grading, crisp detail, luxury lifestyle magazine look. No text, no logos, no watermarks, no brand labels. No faces; people only as elegant hands and wrists. Clear empty space in the upper third of the frame for on-screen text.

frames.name: 00-hook-fold
frames.prompt: Extreme close-up: elegant hands gently folding a Levantine flatbread round made from oats and seeds (no wheat flour), golden with toasted brown spots, visibly speckled with flax, sunflower seeds, sesame and black nigella seeds in half like a soft pita, the bread bending smoothly and flexibly with NO cracks, showing it is soft and pliable, warm steam rising. A small stack of the same breads blurred behind on a linen napkin. 45-degree angle, appetising.

frames.name: 00-hook-fold-b
frames.prompt: Close-up side view: one hand holding a Levantine flatbread round made from oats and seeds (no wheat flour), golden with toasted brown spots, visibly speckled with flax, sunflower seeds, sesame and black nigella seeds and bending it into a soft U-shape fold, the bread supple and tender with no cracking, fresh off the pan with light steam, marble island and linen softly blurred behind.
